retained_records.title: Update Device Drivers - Guide 1
retained_records.content: Install manufacturer-approved device drivers through the approved update channel and restart the computer.

retained_records.title: Re-create VPN Profile - Guide 2
retained_records.content: Remove the damaged VPN connection profile and create a new profile using the approved organization settings. This older article was written for Windows 10 and should be reviewed for newer systems.

retained_records.title: Renew Windows IP Address - Guide 3
retained_records.content: For Wi-Fi connected with no internet, run ipconfig /release followed by ipconfig /renew, then reconnect to the wireless network.
